pages.text: There are tiny living things around us that we cannot see without a microscope.
Some of these tiny things are called bacteria and viruses.
Bacteria are very small living cells.
Some bacteria are helpful and help our bodies digest food.
Viruses are even smaller than bacteria.
Some viruses can make people feel sick.
Our immune system is like a body guard that fights germs.
Washing hands with soap helps remove germs.
Covering coughs and sneezes helps stop germs from spreading.
Healthy food, rest, and clean habits help keep our bodies strong.
